messages:
Ana (Product): Quick thought: move prompt-set metadata into a collapsible right rail during eval runs. Keeps main canvas focused but gives fast access for approvals.

Diego (Design): Agree but let's keep it collapsed by default. Suggest a small badge showing pending approvals count so it's discoverable.

Kai (Engineering): Implementable. Note: streaming diffs + sticky rail can cause layout thrash on low-end CPUs. We can position: fixed with transform to avoid reflow.

Rhea (Accessibility): A11y notes:
- Make rail a modal region with role=document and ensure focus moves into it when opened.
- Close control needs aria-label="Close details".
- Badge needs 4.5:1 contrast and an accessible name like "3 pending approvals".

Tess (QA): Saw a bug: approval button sometimes becomes active while diff is still streaming. Could lead to accidental approves. Recommend disabling the button until run state === "finished".

Ana (Product): Good call. Copy proposal for the CTA: "Approve for rollout". Short, clear. Tooltip when disabled: "Disabled until run finishes."

Diego (Design): Micro-copy tweak: use "Approve for rollout" on desktop but shorten to "Approve" on narrow layouts to avoid truncation.

Rhea (Accessibility): Ensure aria-describedby for the CTA links to the tooltip text so screen readers get context. Also announce when approval completes: "Prompt set approved" via live region.

Kai (Engineering): We'll add client-side 800ms debounce and server-side dedupe by user+run-id. Also lazy-load heavy diffs when the user expands the inline preview to save memory.

Tess (QA): I'll add regression checks: keyboard nav into rail, focus trap, CTA disabled during streaming, debounce tested, and badge contrast.

Design-bot: New Figma frame: https://figma.redwood/rails/PromptRail_v1 created.

Ana (Product): Action items: Diego update mocks with responsive badge + truncated CTA states (EOD Wed). Kai implement debounce/idempotency and lazy-load (PR next Tue). Rhea provide ARIA strings (Mon). Tess add tests (Thu).

Diego (Design): One last UI nit: when rail is collapsed to an icon, increase touch target to 44px.

Kai (Engineering): Will do. Also we should respect prefers-reduced-motion for open/close animation.

Ana (Product): Great, moving to backlog and tagging eng/design for next sprint. :shipit:
